---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: "type: feature, status: needs triage"
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

A clear description of the problem you're trying to solve. Ex: "I'm always frustrated when [...]" or "It would be useful to have [...] because [...]."

## Proposed Solution

Describe what you'd like to see implemented.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've thought about.

## Additional Context

Any other context, mockups, or references (e.g., how other apps solve this).

---

> 💡 **Tip:** Want to discuss an idea before submitting a formal feature request? Start a [Discussion](https://github.com/rbctmz/ai_trainer/discussions/new?category=Feature%20Requests) to gather feedback from the community first.
